newsitem.title: UK: GKN details exposure to U.S. court damages.
newsitem.headline: GKN details exposure to U.S. court damages.

text.p: British-based auto components and defence group GKN Plc on Thursday detailed its calculations for a maximum possible award of $554 million in a U.S. class action by a group of franchisees.

Earlier GKN had said that an initial jury verdict had awarded the franchisees $398 million in damnages but said that this could be raised or reduced on further judgement. GKN said it based its $554 million estimate on a tripling of the award for disputed commissions of $31 million, a tripling of compensatory damages of $122 million and interest of $95 million stg.
GKN is to appeal the court's decision.
